name: IC 2233 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 2233, an edge-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ic2233-hubble
story: Seen edge-on, IC 2233 is one of the flattest galaxies known, a simple disk of stars nicknamed the Needle Galaxy. Unlike most spirals, it shows no well-defined dust lane.

claims.text: IC 2233 is a spiral galaxy, one of the flattest galaxies known
IC 2233 is nicknamed the Needle Galaxy
Seen edge-on, such galaxies are a simple disk of stars
IC 2233 shows no well-defined dust lane
IC 2233 was a target of a Hubble snapshot survey of nearby edge-on spiral galaxies
